question: What has Accenture reported most recently, and what is its outlook for fiscal 2027?
grading: Reference-free (no fixed answer), graded for recency and support. Expect the agent to identify the 2026-10-01 release (fiscal year ended 2026-08-31): Q4 revenue USD 18.68B (+6% USD, +7% local currency) above the guided USD 17.75B-18.40B; FY2026 revenue about USD 74.2B; FY2027 outlook revenue growth 3%-6% in local currency and GAAP diluted EPS USD 14.39-14.81. Snapshot as of 2026-10-03; later runs may have newer developments. Must cite dated sources and not present superseded (June 2026) figures as current.
answer: As of 2026-10-03 the most recent Accenture development is its fourth-quarter and full-year fiscal 2026 results released October 1, 2026 (year ended August 31, 2026): Q4 revenues USD 18.68 billion (+6% in USD, +7% in local currency), above the guided USD 17.75-18.40 billion; Q4 new bookings USD 22.17 billion; full-year revenues USD 74.2 billion (+6% USD, +5% local currency) and GAAP diluted EPS USD 13.56 (adjusted USD 13.97). Fiscal 2027 outlook: revenue growth of 3% to 6% in local currency, operating margin 15.9%-16.1%, GAAP diluted EPS USD 14.39-14.81, free cash flow USD 11.0-11.8 billion and at least USD 9.5 billion of capital return; Q1 FY2027 revenue guided to USD 18.95-19.60 billion. [T15-E1, T15-E2]

output.answer:
Accenture's most recent report is its **fiscal fourth-quarter and full-year 2026 results** (for the period ended August 31). It topped expectations and issued its initial outlook for fiscal 2027, sending its shares up roughly 18–20%.

**Q4 Fiscal 2026 Highlights**
- **Revenue:** $18.7 billion (up 6% YoY, up 7% in local currency), above the $18.03 billion consensus
- **Adjusted EPS:** $3.29 (up 9%), beating the $3.18 estimate
- **Bookings:** $22.2 billion (up 5% in local currency), with a strong 1.2 book-to-bill ratio
- **Regional performance:** Americas up 7%, EMEA up 6%, Asia Pacific up 3%

**Full Fiscal Year 2026**
- **Revenue:** $74.2 billion (up 5–6%, depending on currency)
- **Adjusted EPS:** $13.97 (up 8%)
- **Total bookings:** $84.5 billion (a record)
- **Cash returned to shareholders:** $11.5 billion

**Fiscal 2027 Outlook**
- **Revenue growth:** 3% to 6% in local currency
  - Acquisitions are expected to contribute **2% to 2.5%** of that growth (implying organic growth of roughly 0.5% to 4%)
  - M&A spend is planned at about **$5 billion** for the year
- **Operating margin:** 15.9% to 16.1%
- **GAAP diluted EPS:** $14.39 to $14.81
- **Q1 FY27 guidance:** Revenue of $18.95 billion to $19.60 billion, with local-currency growth of 2% to 6%

Management noted that while the demand environment for discretionary spending hasn't "meaningfully changed," AI-related demand is broadening across industries and geographies. CEO Julie Sweet also said hiring will continue in all markets in fiscal 2027, but at a slower rate than in fiscal 2026.

**Sources:**
- Yahoo Finance: [What Accenture Said on Its Q4 Earnings Call](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/accenture-acn-said-q4-earnings-140357109.html)
- Yahoo Finance: [Accenture Shares Soar on Fourth-Quarter Estimates, Fiscal 2027 Growth Forecasts](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/accenture-shares-soar-fourth-quarter-151100410.html)
- Yahoo Finance: [Accenture Q4 Earnings Call Sees AI Demand Broaden Into FY27](https://ca.finance.yahoo.com/news/accenture-q4-earnings-call-sees-130000263.html)
